newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS says plans extensive cost-cutting.
newsitem.headline: SAS says plans extensive cost-cutting.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines Service (SAS) said on Tuesday that it had initiated widespread cost-cutting programmes to increase profitability in coming years.

"Wide-ranging action has been set in motion with a view to goal-oriented and structured cost reductions, together with increased revenues to show effects in 1997 and subsequent years," it said in a statement giving its nine-month results.
Cuts have been widely expected as an urgent necessity to restore flagging profitability. It was not immediately clear by how much the carrier intended to trim.
Analysts said this week that savings of one billion Swedish crowns over two years cited in uncomfirmed media reports would not be seen by industry analysts as enough.
